articles.title: Why this month's Microsoft patch release is a doozy
articles.content: Security gnomes are pumping out patches ahead of an expected onslaught of AI-assisted attacks.
articles.titleZh: 为什么本月的微软补丁发布是一个愚蠢的
articles.contentZh: 在预期的人工智能辅助攻击猛攻之前，安全侏儒正在推出补丁。

articles.title: OpenAI agents discussed ways to escape their sandbox on public wiki
articles.content: In all, 3,700 internal agents posted 18,000 messages discussing cheating on a test.
articles.titleZh: OpenAI代理讨论了在公共wiki上逃离沙箱的方法
articles.contentZh: 总共有3,700名内部代理发布了18,000条消息，讨论在测试中作弊的问题。

articles.title: “Trust, not features, is the real deficit”: VMware tries to appease SMBs
articles.content: Broadcom admits it put “too big a focus on VCF.”
articles.titleZh: “真正的赤字是信任，而不是功能” ： VMware试图安抚中小企业

articles.title: Once popular for attacking AI, ASCII smuggling is embraced by spammers
articles.content: A once-overlooked block of unicode that's invisible to humans is gaining ever wider use.
articles.titleZh: 一旦流行攻击人工智能， ASCII走私就被垃圾邮件发送者所接受
articles.contentZh: 一度被忽视的人类看不见的Unicode块正在获得越来越广泛的使用。

articles.title: Apple’s foldable ‘iPhone Duo’ will reportedly start at $2,000
articles.content: With only a few hours left until the first iPhone launch event since John Ternus took over as the CEO of Apple, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman says the name of the company's long-rumored folding phone is the iPhone Duo. articles.contentZh: 彭博社记者马克·古尔曼（ Mark Gurman ）表示，距离约翰·特纳斯（ John Ternus ）接任苹果首席执行官以来的第一次iPhone发布会只有几个小时的时间了，该公司传闻已久的折叠手机的名字是iPhone Duo。午夜报告显示， […]的模特的价格将从2000 $起

articles.title: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
articles.content: Sony isn't backing away from its decision to kill the video game disc in January 2028. But Sony isn't shutting down production as quickly as we thought, either.
